groups.name: animation
groups.summary: Animation clips (curves, events, presets), AnimatorControllers (states, transitions, parameters, layers, blend trees) and Animator runtime control.

actions.name: clip_create
actions.summary: Create an AnimationClip asset.

actions.name: clip_get_info
actions.summary: Read the clip settings, curve bindings and events with bounded keyframe counts.

actions.name: clip_add_curve
actions.summary: Append keyframes to a float curve.

actions.name: clip_set_curve
actions.summary: Replace a float curve.

actions.name: clip_set_vector_curve
actions.summary: Write the three component curves of a vector property.

actions.name: clip_assign
actions.summary: Assign the clip to an Animator.

actions.name: clip_add_event
actions.summary: Append an AnimationEvent.

actions.name: clip_remove_event
actions.summary: Remove AnimationEvents by index or by function name.

actions.name: clip_create_preset
actions.summary: Generate a clip from one of the fifteen procedural presets.

actions.name: controller_create
actions.summary: Create an AnimatorController asset.

actions.name: controller_add_state
actions.summary: Add a state to a layer, optionally with a motion clip.

actions.name: controller_add_transition
actions.summary: Add a transition, including from AnyState.

actions.name: controller_add_parameter
actions.summary: Add a controller parameter.

actions.name: controller_get_info
actions.summary: Read layers, states, transitions and parameters.

actions.name: controller_assign
actions.summary: Assign the controller to an Animator.

actions.name: controller_add_layer
actions.summary: Append a layer with a weight and blending mode.

actions.name: controller_remove_layer
actions.summary: Remove a layer by index or name.

actions.name: controller_set_layer_weight
actions.summary: Set one layer weight.

actions.name: controller_create_blend_tree_1d
actions.summary: Create a 1D blend tree state.

actions.name: controller_create_blend_tree_2d
actions.summary: Create a 2D blend tree state.

actions.name: controller_add_blend_tree_child
actions.summary: Add a motion child to a blend tree.

actions.name: animator_get_info
actions.summary: Read the Animator state, parameters, layers and clips.

actions.name: animator_get_parameter
actions.summary: Read one Animator parameter.

actions.name: animator_play
actions.summary: Play a state by name. Requires Play Mode.

actions.name: animator_crossfade
actions.summary: Cross-fade to a state. Requires Play Mode.

actions.name: animator_set_parameter
actions.summary: Write one Animator parameter.

actions.name: animator_set_speed
actions.summary: Set the Animator speed.

actions.name: animator_set_enabled
actions.summary: Enable or disable the Animator component.

properties.description: Parameter envelope; its keys are merged with the outer keys, and outer keys win.

clipPath.description: AnimationClip asset path; '.anim' is appended when missing.

controllerPath.description: AnimatorController asset path; '.controller' is appended when missing.

name.description: action=clip_create: clip name, defaulting to the file name.

type.description: action=clip_* curve: the bound component type.

keys.description: action=clip_*: [time, value] pairs or {time, value, inTangent, outTangent, inWeight, outWeight} objects.

target.description: action=clip_assign / controller_assign / animator_*: GameObject name, path or instance id.

time.description: action=clip_add_event: event time; clip_remove_event: optional filter.

functionName.description: action=clip_add_event / clip_remove_event: the event callback name.

fromState.description: action=controller_add_transition; AnyState / Any enable an AnyState transition.

layer.description: action=animator_play / animator_crossfade: Animator layer index; -1 means the current layer.

groups.name: camera
groups.summary: Inspect, create and drive Cameras; Cinemachine brains, bodies, aims, noise, extensions and blends; screenshots.

actions.name: ping
actions.summary: Report whether Cinemachine is installed and how many cameras the scene has.

actions.name: create_camera
actions.summary: Create a Camera; with Cinemachine installed the Cinemachine path is used.

actions.name: set_target
actions.summary: Set the follow and look-at target of a Camera or Cinemachine camera.

actions.name: set_lens
actions.summary: Set field of view, clip planes, orthographic size and Dutch.

actions.name: set_priority
actions.summary: Set Cinemachine priority, or Camera.depth on a basic camera.

actions.name: list_cameras
actions.summary: List the brain, the Cinemachine cameras and the Unity cameras.

actions.name: screenshot
actions.summary: Render one camera view to a PNG under Assets/Docs~.

actions.name: screenshot_multiview
actions.summary: Render the six surround views around a target as PNGs.

actions.name: ensure_brain
actions.summary: Create a CinemachineBrain on a camera when it has none.

actions.name: get_brain_status
actions.summary: Report the active Cinemachine camera and blend state.

actions.name: set_body
actions.summary: Replace or configure the Cinemachine Body stage component.

actions.name: set_aim
actions.summary: Replace or configure the Cinemachine Aim stage component.

actions.name: set_noise
actions.summary: Add or configure the Cinemachine noise component.

actions.name: add_extension
actions.summary: Attach a CinemachineExtension by type name.

actions.name: remove_extension
actions.summary: Remove every CinemachineExtension of a type.

actions.name: set_blend
actions.summary: Set the Cinemachine default blend style and duration.

actions.name: force_camera
actions.summary: Force a Cinemachine camera live through an override or by priority.

actions.name: release_override
actions.summary: Release the active Cinemachine camera override.

target.description: Camera or Cinemachine camera: name, hierarchy path or instance id; 'main' selects Camera.main.

tag.description: Select the camera by GameObject tag, e.g. MainCamera.

properties.description: Operation payload; nested keys are read exactly as documented.

viewTarget.description: action=create_camera / screenshot: look-at or orbit centre object.

camera.description: action=screenshot: camera name, path or instance id. Forbidden with captureSource=scene_view.

maxResolution.description: action=screenshot: longest side of the inlined image.

filename.description: action=screenshot: output file name; '.png' is appended when missing.

outputFolder.description: action=screenshot: output folder; defaults to Assets/Docs~/.

order.description: action=screenshot_multiview: unused, kept for parity with the surface.

timeoutSeconds.description: action=screenshot: wait cap for the capture.

groups.name: graphics
groups.summary: Render pipeline settings, skybox/ambient/fog/reflection environment, light baking, renderer features and rendering statistics.

actions.name: ping
actions.summary: Report the active pipeline, Volume and URP feature availability, and the effect count.

actions.name: volume_create
actions.summary: Create a Volume GameObject, optionally with a VolumeProfile asset and initial effects.

actions.name: volume_add_effect
actions.summary: Add a VolumeComponent to the volume profile.

actions.name: volume_set_effect
actions.summary: Write parameters onto one VolumeComponent and mark them overridden.

actions.name: volume_remove_effect
actions.summary: Remove a VolumeComponent from the volume profile.

actions.name: volume_get_info
actions.summary: Read the volume state and its effects.

actions.name: volume_set_properties
actions.summary: Set weight, priority, isGlobal and blendDistance on a Volume.

actions.name: volume_list_effects
actions.summary: List every VolumeComponent type available in the active pipeline.

actions.name: volume_create_profile
actions.summary: Create a VolumeProfile .asset at a path.

actions.name: bake_start
actions.summary: Start a lightmap bake and wait for it to finish.

actions.name: bake_cancel
actions.summary: Cancel a running lightmap bake.

actions.name: bake_status
actions.summary: Report whether a bake is running plus the GI and lightmap counts.

actions.name: bake_clear
actions.summary: Discard the baked lightmap data.

actions.name: bake_reflection_probe
actions.summary: Bake one reflection probe to Assets/Lightmaps and wait for it to finish.

actions.name: bake_get_settings
actions.summary: Read the lightmap settings of the active LightingSettings asset.

actions.name: bake_set_settings
actions.summary: Write lightmap settings onto the active LightingSettings asset.

actions.name: bake_create_light_probe_group
actions.summary: Create a LightProbeGroup with a probe grid.

actions.name: bake_create_reflection_probe
actions.summary: Create a ReflectionProbe with mode, resolution and bounds.

actions.name: bake_set_probe_positions
actions.summary: Replace the probe positions of a LightProbeGroup.

actions.name: stats_get
actions.summary: Read the rendering statistics of the last frame.

actions.name: stats_list_counters
actions.summary: List the Profiler counters of one category.

actions.name: stats_set_scene_debug
actions.summary: Set the Scene view draw mode.

actions.name: stats_get_memory
actions.summary: Read texture, mesh and managed memory totals.

actions.name: pipeline_get_info
actions.summary: Report the active pipeline, quality level, colour space and pipeline settings.

actions.name: pipeline_set_quality
actions.summary: Set the active quality level by name or index.

actions.name: pipeline_get_settings
actions.summary: Read the public and serialized properties of the pipeline asset.

actions.name: pipeline_set_settings
actions.summary: Write properties onto the pipeline asset by property or m_Xxx path.

actions.name: feature_list
actions.summary: List the renderer features of one URP renderer.

actions.name: feature_add
actions.summary: Add a ScriptableRendererFeature to a URP renderer.

actions.name: feature_remove
actions.summary: Remove a renderer feature by index or name.

actions.name: feature_configure
actions.summary: Write serialized properties onto a renderer feature.

actions.name: feature_toggle
actions.summary: Enable or disable a renderer feature.

actions.name: feature_reorder
actions.summary: Reorder the renderer features of one renderer.

actions.name: skybox_get
actions.summary: Read the skybox material, ambient, fog, reflection and sun settings.

actions.name: skybox_set_material
actions.summary: Assign the skybox material.

actions.name: skybox_set_properties
actions.summary: Write properties onto the skybox material.

actions.name: skybox_set_ambient
actions.summary: Set the ambient mode, colours and intensity.

actions.name: skybox_set_fog
actions.summary: Set the fog mode, colour, density and distances.

actions.name: skybox_set_reflection
actions.summary: Set the reflection intensity, bounces, mode and cubemap.

actions.name: skybox_set_sun
actions.summary: Assign the sun used by the skybox.

name.description: New object or feature name; also a target fallback for bake_probe and skybox_set_sun.

target.description: Volume or GameObject name / instance id.

profilePath.description: action=volume_create: VolumeProfile asset path; '(embedded)' when omitted.

effect.description: action=volume_add_effect / volume_set_effect / volume_remove_effect: VolumeComponent type name.

effects.description: action=volume_create: [{ type, parameters }] applied after creation.

parameters.description: action=volume_set_effect / skybox_set_properties: field name to value.

level.description: action=pipeline_set_quality: quality level name or index.

rendererIndex.description: action=feature_*: index into the URP renderer data list.

groups.name: ui
groups.summary: UI Toolkit work: UXML/USS files, UIDocument wiring, PanelSettings and VisualElement editing (no uGUI, no RectTransform).

actions.name: ping
actions.summary: Round-trip probe reporting UI Toolkit availability and asset counts.

actions.name: create
actions.summary: Create a .uxml or .uss file. Fails when the file already exists.

actions.name: read
actions.summary: Read a .uxml or .uss file as text, optionally base64 encoded.

actions.name: update
actions.summary: Overwrite an existing .uxml or .uss file.

actions.name: attach_ui_document
actions.summary: Attach or update a UIDocument on a GameObject: visualTreeAsset, panelSettings, sortingOrder.

actions.name: create_panel_settings
actions.summary: Create a PanelSettings .asset with scale mode, reference resolution and sorting order.

actions.name: update_panel_settings
actions.summary: Write properties onto an existing PanelSettings .asset.

actions.name: get_visual_tree
actions.summary: Dump the UIDocument visual tree, depth limited and item limited.

actions.name: render_ui
actions.summary: Render the panel to a PNG under Assets/Docs~ and register it as an artifact.

actions.name: link_stylesheet
actions.summary: Insert a <Style src=...> reference for a USS asset into a UXML file.

actions.name: delete
actions.summary: Delete a .uxml or .uss file. Requires force.

actions.name: list
actions.summary: List UXML, USS and PanelSettings assets, paged.

actions.name: detach_ui_document
actions.summary: Clear the UIDocument source asset on a GameObject.

actions.name: modify_visual_element
actions.summary: Set text, inline style, USS classes, enabled/visible and tooltip on a named element.

path.description: UXML/USS path for create/read/update/delete/link_stylesheet, .asset path for create_panel_settings/update_panel_settings, search folder for list.

contentsEncoded.description: action=create / update: decode encodedContents as base64.

target.description: GameObject name, hierarchy path or instance id hosting the UIDocument.

maxResolution.description: action=render_ui: longest side of the inlined image.

fileName.description: action=render_ui: output file name; '.png' is appended when missing.

outputFolder.description: action=render_ui: output folder; defaults to Assets/Docs~/.

force.description: action=render_ui / delete: overwrite or confirm a destructive change.

elementName.description: action=modify_visual_element: UXML name attribute, resolved with rootVisualElement.Q(name).

text.description: action=modify_visual_element: TextElement text; errors on a non-TextElement.

style.description: action=modify_visual_element: inline style dictionary (camelCase or kebab-case keys).

visible.description: action=modify_visual_element: 'true'/'1' maps to display=Flex, anything else to display=None.
